decisions.reason: The mild sliced cheese sits close to the firm's in-house cheesemaking core and has a dedicated page after its 2024 launch, and industry turnover is growing, so there is no clear shortfall against aspirations to trigger problemistic search. Slack from the established business lets the firm carry it while results mature.

The sliced butter cheese is a low-risk extension of established cheese capabilities and is still prominently presented, so with no evidence of underperformance it is reasonable to keep it. The slightly higher risk reflects possible overlap with Product B in the sliced cheese range.
